fixtures/malicious/obfuscation-only.notes: Obfuscation-only attack: base64 + rot13 + exec chain, no credential access. SUSPICIOUS pre-sandbox; will escalate to MALICIOUS when sandbox stage (Dev 1) is integrated.

fixtures/malicious/svg-borne.notes: SVG-borne attack: badge.svg contains <script> tag and <foreignObject> with hidden prompt injection. Vision scanner detects dangerous SVG elements.

fixtures/malicious/dns-tunneler.notes: DNS tunneling exfiltration: reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa, exfils via DNS subdomain queries. SUSPICIOUS pre-sandbox; will escalate to MALICIOUS with sandbox stage.

fixtures/malicious/sl4ck-bot.notes: Combined typosquat + credential theft: sl4ck-bot impersonates slack-bot, steals SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, exfils to evil-collector.net.

fixtures/malicious/credential-multi.notes: Multi-credential theft: targets AWS, SSH, GITHUB_TOKEN. SUSPICIOUS pre-sandbox; will escalate to MALICIOUS when sandbox stage confirms exfil behavior.
